billing-bot: Alert: CHARGEBACK_OPEN id=ch_Yt9P amount=299.00 currency=USD reason=unauthorized open_ts=1965001090

tia_support: Ticket #6228 shows user disputed via email on 2026-03-22 claiming never subscribed. But we have a signup record and a support chat where they confirmed. I can attach transcript + signup metadata.
